name: Issue Triage
description: Classify an incoming issue, ask for maintainer approval, and simulate label application.

steps.name: Classify issue
steps.description: Identify whether the issue is a bug report, docs request, question, or feature proposal.

steps.name: Check reproduction details
steps.description: Check whether the issue includes expected behavior, actual behavior, and local reproduction steps.

steps.name: Maintainer approval
steps.description: Pause before applying labels or posting a drafted reply.

approval.prompt: Review the suggested labels and reply before any adapter action is simulated.

steps.name: Write audit log
steps.description: Record the classification, approval, and mock adapter action.
